sources.title: GitHub - muscriptor/muscriptor: A multi-instrument music transcription ...
sources.snippet: MuScriptor is a multi-instrument music transcription model developed by Kyutai and Mirelo. MuScriptor is the first music transcription model that has been trained on a large scale dataset of 170k songs from classical music to heavy metal.

sources.title: cocktailpeanut/muscriptor-large · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MuScriptor is an open-weight model for general-purpose, multi-instrument automatic music transcription (AMT): it converts a music recording (any genre, multiple simultaneous instruments) into a stream of notes played. This repository hosts the large variant (≈1.3B parameters) — the flagship, best-quality checkpoint.

sources.title: MuScriptor: An Open Model for Multi-Instrument Music Transcription
sources.snippet: We further introduce conditioning on instrument presence to customize transcriptions. Finally, we release MuScriptor, an open-weight multi-instrument music transcription model that works on real-world music recordings from across a diverse range of musical genres.

sources.title: MuScriptor - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: An open-source multi-instrument audio-to-MIDI transcription model that converts full song mixes into separate MIDI tracks for each instrument (voice, drums, bass, keys, and others), representing music transcription as a token-based language modeling task.
